confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from a web search result that reported the RBA figure for 2026-11-18 (USD 0.6720 per AUD). I did not open the RBA page myself. Food and drink anchors are based on crowd-sourced cost-of-living averages found in search: MyLifeElsewhere, Expatica citing Numbeo (June 2026), and Traveltables (2023). Those averages are user-reported, and tourist beach venues cost more, so I adjusted upward for typical tourist-area prices. No source gave cocktail or wine-by-the-glass prices. Cocktail is estimated at about 3x beer and wine glass at about 3.5x beer, based on typical Thai tourist-venue relationships. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge. I did not search for accommodation prices or inspect listings. Samui accommodation varies a lot by season and location.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other Thai island tourist destinations such as Phuket and Krabi. Koh Samui restaurant prices run about 12% above the Thailand average in the sources found.
